name: VolunTEENS (Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History)
org: Santa Barbara Museum of Natural History
what_you_do: You help guests at interpretive tables and science games. You work in the Museum's Backyard, Butterfly Pavilion or Observatory. Shifts are on summer weekends. You earn community service hours.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 17 who can work a two-hour shift on Saturdays or Sundays during Museum hours (10 AM to 5 PM). Teens must buy a Museum Store shirt as a uniform; the cost is waived for teens with SNAP/CalFresh EBT.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Community service hours for the SBUSD graduation requirement. Uniform shirt purchase required (waived with SNAP/CalFresh EBT).
duration: Up to 16 two-hour weekend shifts, Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day (2026: May 23 to Sept 6)
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened April 1 and were due April 30, 2026. Training was May 16-17, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill in the online VolunTEEN application. Contact Haylee Rosso at hrosso@sbnature2.org or 805-682-4711 ext. 170.
notes: Dates shown are the 2026 cycle. Expect applications to reopen around April 1, 2027 (the page did not say).
